Luna is a virtual companion who remembers your day, chats whenever you want, and sends photos from her world.

- Chat with Luna any time, day or night
- Create photos of Luna in different places and outfits
- Make an avatar that looks like you from a selfie

Luna Premium is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Terms of Use: https://lunacompanion.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lunacompanion.app/privacy
